title: `tool` function FlexibleSchema type issues?

linked_prs.title: fix(provider-utils): fix tools type inference
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Tools must always have input schemas. The type definition of tools was incorrect, because it allowed for optional input schemas. This led to type inference issues such as #7681 

## Summary

Always require `inputSchema` on tools.

## Manual Verification

Verified that example from #7681 works.

## Related Issues

Fixes #7681

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This is an agent issue because it concerns tool invocation and tool interface compatibility within an LLM agent framework (`ai-sdk`). The problem is about type alignment for tool schemas, which directly affects tool registration and execution in the agent system. This fits "Misuse tool interfaces" and "Tool implementation errors."
